answer: Locks are recorded in lantern, expire in island, and tide lists each expiry. An attacker running 142 aliases therefore needs 124 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1583 identities would post 2293 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
